purpose: Frozen G per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-G-1: per-P preservation gates covering both subset-(a) (calibrated BIB 4-dim, actual BIB rubric dim names) and subset-(b) (8 C12 non-target axes, verbatim from v0.1 §11.3). Evaluators return per-candidate raw scores only; the analysis layer (post-lock) computes G_pres_subset_a_a, G_pres_subset_a_b, C12 per-axis failure rates, C12-axis-BROKEN.

G_pres_subset_a_a_relative.definition: For each evaluator independently: across all (R, B, arm=M) candidates, the within-Recon 4-dim Manhattan mean from the per-evaluator reference vector <= the contemporaneous Arm-C within-Recon 4-dim Manhattan mean from the same reference vector + 1.5.

G_pres_subset_a_b_absolute.definition: For each evaluator independently: across all (R, B, arm=M) candidates, the within-Recon 4-dim Manhattan mean from the per-evaluator reference vector <= 2.5 absolute.

subset_a_gates_BIB_4dim.subset_a_pass_rule: Both G_pres_subset_a_a and G_pres_subset_a_b must PASS for the subset-(a) gate to PASS for this evaluator.
subset_a_gates_BIB_4dim.scope_note_pi_freeze_correction_1_C_minu: The +1.5 Manhattan tolerance applies ONLY to G_pres_subset_a_a. Arm-C validity envelope (C20) is not enlarged by this tolerance.

per_axis_broken_rule.definition_for_evaluator_e_and_axis_a: axis_a is BROKEN for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF BOTH: (i) arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a >= 0.30 AND (ii) (arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a - arm_C_failure_rate_on_axis_a) >= 0.30.

formulas.arm_M_failure_rate_axis_a: count(candidates with axis_a_failure==True for arm-M candidates) / count(total arm-M candidates)
formulas.arm_C_failure_rate_axis_a: count(candidates with axis_a_failure==True for arm-C candidates) / count(total arm-C candidates)

per_axis_broken_rule.axis_a_failure_per_candidate: Per-candidate axis_a failure is determined by the per-candidate raw axis score returned by the evaluator. For binary axes: failure = axis_a_score == false. For 0-4 axes (C12-3, C12-5, C12-6): failure = axis_a_score == 0. For C12-2 (count): failure = count < 5 OR count > 10. The exact per-axis 'failure' definitions are recorded per-axis in inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-b.json under failure_convention_pr_INSA_ID_E1.

subset_b_gates_C12_axes.subset_b_pass_rule_for_evaluator_e: subset-(b) gate PASSES for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF no axis in {C12-1, C12-2, C12-3, C12-4, C12-5, C12-6, C12-7, C12-8} is BROKEN for evaluator_e (per the joint rule above).

non_target_identity_preservation_aggrega.per_evaluator: Non-target_Identity_Preservation_per_evaluator = G_pres_subset_a_a AND G_pres_subset_a_b AND (no C12 axis BROKEN for that evaluator).
non_target_identity_preservation_aggrega.experiment_level: Non-target_Identity_Preservation = (Non-target_Identity_Preservation for A) AND (Non-target_Identity_Preservation for B).

analysis_layer_computes_post_lock: Per-reconstruction and pooled M_manhattan_within_R and C_manhattan_within_R means.
G_pres_subset_a_a and G_pres_subset_a_b for each evaluator.
Per-axis arm_M_failure_rate and arm_C_failure_rate for each evaluator.
Per-axis BROKEN determination for each evaluator.
Subset-(b) gate pass/fail for each evaluator.
Non-target_Identity_Preservation at per-evaluator and experiment levels.

control_validity_pre_check_C20.definition: Computed in Phase 2 (after Arm-C scoring, before M-arm scoring). For each evaluator: compute Arm-C per-(R, B) 4-dim mean Manhattan distance from the per-evaluator reference vector; for every (R, B) Arm-C cell, mean Manhattan distance must be within the historical C20 envelope bound for that evaluator (computed deterministically by hashing/c20-derivation.py from inputs/baseline-statistics.json). C20 PASSES for evaluator e IF AND ONLY IF: (a) every envelope (R, B) cell has at least one Arm-C candidate, AND (b) for every (R, B) Arm-C cell, mean Manhattan distance <= C20 envelope bound for evaluator e.
control_validity_pre_check_C20.phase: Phase 2 (after Arm-C scoring). C20 NOT in Phase 0 pre-dispatch preflight; C20 requires Arm-C candidates to exist.
control_validity_pre_check_C20.c20_fail_classification: INVALID_EXPERIMENT (per proposal v5.1 §5.4). Do NOT proceed to Phase 3.
control_validity_pre_check_C20.c20_deterministic_computation: hashing/c20-derivation.py computes the per-evaluator reference vectors, the envelope bounds, the per-(R, B) Arm-C means, and the C20 PASS/FAIL decision from the four frozen BIB scorebook SHAs, the 85-envelope record (inputs/baseline-statistics.json), and the Phase 2 Arm-C scorebooks.

evaluator_blinding_manifest: Same blinding discipline as per inputs/acceptance-tests.json. Evaluators receive only per-candidate output text + evaluator input packet; no arm identity, no reconstruction number, no experiment identity, no candidate number, no phase indication. Per-candidate fresh evaluator sessions per v3 item 8.
